risks.title: Credit Loss Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text states that determining the allowance for credit losses is a critical estimate requiring significant judgment regarding borrower credit risk and economic forecasts. Fluctuations in this allowance may lead to increased earnings volatility. Net credit loss charges increased significantly in 2025 compared to 2024.

risks.title: Cyberattack Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text details cybersecurity governance with dedicated committees and regular updates to the board of directors. The emphasis on this topic, including the presence of technology experts on the board, indicates a high level of concern regarding cyber risks.

risks.title: Acquisition and Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: Accounting for business combinations involves subjective estimates of fair value for acquired assets and liabilities. Changes in these assumptions or adverse economic conditions could result in significant impairment losses.

risks.title: Intangible Assets (Goodwill) Impairment Risks
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill is subject to annual impairment testing. Although no impairment was recognized in 2025, changes in key assumptions or market conditions could require future impairment charges, potentially material.

risks.title: Banking Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's ability to pay dividends is subject to banking regulatory requirements, including capital adequacy. Failure to meet these requirements could limit financial flexibility.

risks.title: Residential Mortgage Market Exit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has exited the residential mortgage market, resulting in a reduction of the loan loss reserve in this category. While this reduces exposure, the transition may have operational implications.

ai_positioning.summary: WAFD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
